description: Data-access layer + TanStack Query hooks + tests. Pure async data-access functions for macro goals over the typed Supabase client with PostgrestError mapped to clear non-leaky Errors, a QueryClientProvider setup, useMacroGoal() read hook and useSaveMacroGoal() upsert mutation hook (invalidates the query on success) exposing isLoading/isError and isPending, with NO useEffect for fetching. Unit tests for the data functions (mocked client: success + error-mapping) and hook tests (query/mutation loading->success and error states) via a QueryClient wrapper. Depends on FEAT-001 (client) and FEAT-002 (types).
steps: Create apps/macros-web/src/features/macro-goals/types.ts: a domain-facing MacroGoal type and a SaveMacroGoalInput type derived from the DB Insert type (Omit server-managed columns), plus a GOAL_TYPES const tuple ['deficit','mantenimiento','volumen'] (frozen) reused by any future zod schema. NO any.

Create apps/macros-web/src/features/macro-goals/macroGoals.data.ts: pure async functions taking the SupabaseClient<Database> as a parameter (dependency injection so tests pass a mock, no module-level client import). getActiveMacroGoal(client, userId): selects the active macro_goal for the user, returns MacroGoal | null (maybeSingle); maps any PostgrestError to a clear Error via a small toClearError(context, error) helper that does NOT leak raw internals. saveMacroGoal(client, input): upserts the goal (insert; the partial unique index + is_active handles single-active, document the chosen upsert strategy e.g. deactivate-then-insert or on_conflict) and returns the saved MacroGoal; maps errors. Keep each function < 50 lines; immutable (no param mutation).
Create apps/macros-web/src/features/macro-goals/queryKeys.ts: a frozen factory, e.g. macroGoalKeys.active(userId) => ['macro-goal','active',userId] as const.

Create apps/macros-web/src/app/queryClient.ts and a QueryProvider component (or src/features/macro-goals/QueryProvider.tsx): export a configured QueryClient (sensible defaults: retry false in test-friendly config, staleTime) and a QueryClientProvider wrapper. Wire the provider at the app root (main.tsx or App.tsx) WITHOUT breaking the existing view switch.

Create apps/macros-web/src/features/macro-goals/useMacroGoal.ts: useMacroGoal(userId) using useQuery with queryKey macroGoalKeys.active(userId), queryFn calling getActiveMacroGoal(getSupabaseClient(), userId), enabled: Boolean(userId). Return { data, isLoading, isError, error }. NO useEffect.

Create apps/macros-web/src/features/macro-goals/useSaveMacroGoal.ts: useSaveMacroGoal(userId) using useMutation whose mutationFn calls saveMacroGoal(getSupabaseClient(), input), and onSuccess invalidates macroGoalKeys.active(userId) via queryClient.invalidateQueries. Return { mutate, mutateAsync, isPending, isError, error }.

Tests (apps/macros-web/src/features/macro-goals/__tests__/): macroGoals.data.test.ts — mock the Supabase client query-builder chain (from().select().eq().maybeSingle() and the upsert/insert path); assert success returns mapped data, assert a PostgrestError throws a clear Error whose message does NOT include raw internals, assert null-row returns null. useMacroGoal.test.tsx and useSaveMacroGoal.test.tsx — renderHook with a QueryClientProvider wrapper (retry:false), mock macroGoals.data functions; assert loading->success data, assert isError on rejection, and for the mutation assert isPending transitions and that onSuccess invalidates the query (spy on queryClient.invalidateQueries).
Keep the no-console rule green: if the user wants a save-success log seam, route it through an optional injected callback, never console.
acceptance_criteria: getActiveMacroGoal and saveMacroGoal are pure async functions that accept the client as a parameter, return typed data or throw a clear mapped Error (no raw PostgrestError leakage), and mutate no inputs.
useMacroGoal exposes isLoading/isError and useSaveMacroGoal exposes isPending/isError; the mutation invalidates the macro-goal query on success; no useEffect is used for fetching.
A QueryClientProvider is configured and wired at the app root.
cd apps/macros-web && npm run test -- --run passes including the new data + hook tests, with coverage >= 80% on the new files, and npm run typecheck/lint/build are clean (no any, no console).
verification: cd apps/macros-web && npm run test:coverage  (confirm >=80% on src/features/macro-goals and src/lib)
cd apps/macros-web && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
